justification: Omar Cooper's Out, and Out ain't hurt, Out is a guy who ain't walking through that door Sunday, so he don't ride in my lineup when I got Germie Bernard sitting right there healthy and hungry — that's not loyalty, that's just not being stupid. Javonte Williams has been doing the dirty work every week and this week the kid's projected near twenty against a Tennessee front that's got nothing to give, so he steps in over Breece Hall — backs are the engine, I don't need a spreadsheet to tell me that twice, I just happen to agree with it this time. Lawrence stays under center, he's my guy, threw for 352 last week and I don't churn a quarterback for half a dollar in projections when Nix is sitting right behind him. LaPorta, Chase Brown, Washington, Bates, and the Buffalo D ride as-is — they ain't done nothing to lose their chair, and I don't bench people over a bad month, I bench 'em when they stop showing up, and nobody here's stopped showing up except a guy who physically can't.
